description: This file defines a custom React hook `useLocalStorage` that provides a way to persist state via the browser's localStorage. It includes helper functions to safely parse JSON and manages hydration state to synchronize with localStorage.

methods.name: safeJsonParse(raw, fallbackValue)
methods.description: Safely parses a JSON string and returns a fallback value if parsing fails.

methods.name: useLocalStorage(key, initialValue)
methods.description: A React hook that synchronizes a state with localStorage, initializing the state from localStorage if available, otherwise using an initial value. It provides a setter that updates both the state and localStorage.
